issue: Is unemployment a BEAI input? §11 lists eight indicators without it; §14 uses unemployment as its example of a rate variable with a direction rule.
decision: NOT a primary BEAI input. Primary BEAI = the eight §11 indicators. Unemployment is predictor-only (beai_eligible = N).
deviation_detail: §11's explicit list is treated as controlling over §14's illustrative example, so §14's unemployment rule is not instantiated in the primary label. To change this, amend §11/§19 (e.g. 6/9) and flip beai_eligible for LAB_UNEMP; its Pipeline-A transform (first difference, sign flipped) is already described in its notes.

issue: §11 says 'Business investment'. Is total GFCF an acceptable substitute where a business series is missing?
decision: Strict: business (non-residential) fixed investment only. Total GFCF is not substituted; where business investment is missing the component counts as missing.
deviation_detail: No deviation; the cost is possibly lower coverage.
remaining_action: Verify which countries publish non-residential GFCF quarterly.

issue: Retail/sales: which concept, and what if no official retail series exists (India, China)?
decision: Real retail trade volume, or retail sales deflated by headline CPI from the same chain source. No unofficial proxy (cards, GST e-way bills, auto sales) substitutes; missing stays missing.
remaining_action: Verify official retail series for IND and CHN.

issue: Employment and real-income concepts (national accounts vs labour-force survey vs establishment survey; disposable vs personal income less transfers).
decision: Employment: national-accounts quarterly employment preferred, LFS monthly (quarterly mean) as fallback; one concept is locked per country at the audit and counted once toward §19. Real income: household disposable income, deflated by headline CPI if only nominal.

issue: Hours worked: what if only annual data exist?
decision: Quarterly total hours only. Annual-only means the component is missing; no temporal disaggregation.
remaining_action: Verify quarterly hours availability per country (likely missing for IND, CHN).

issue: India or China may fail the >=6/8 rule (employment, hours, income, retail may lack long quarterly histories). Relax §19 for them?
decision: No. §19 is applied uniformly with no relaxation for any country. A country that fails gets no BEAI-based Label A; it stays in coverage reporting. Labels B and C remain robustness labels, not substitutes.
deviation_detail: No deviation; India is a Tier-1 case study, so a failure would be a reported finding.
remaining_action: Outcome unknown until the B01/B03 coverage audit.

issue: India GDP: new series base 2022-23 released 2026-02-27 (verified); new-series quarterly estimates only from Q1 FY2022-23; back series reported due Dec 2026 (secondary source). How to splice?
decision: Collect legacy (2011-12 and earlier) and new (2022-23) series; splice by chaining log growth rates over the overlap quarters; no level splicing; record overlap, break dates and back-series status in base_year_changes.
deviation_detail: The plan requires base-year changes to be recorded but does not prescribe a splice method; growth-rate chaining is my choice.
remaining_action: Check MoSPI for the published back series and the legacy quarterly start date.

issue: IIP base 2022-23, CPI base 2024, Output PPI base 2022-23 reported by secondary sources; legacy WPI status unknown.
decision: Same splice rule as Q-07. If both WPI and the new PPI exist, collect both; the series with the longer continuous history is primary.
deviation_detail: Splice and primary-series tie-break are my choices; the plan is silent.

issue: Fiscal-year quarters and PLFS discontinuities (urban-only quarterly 2017-2024; revamp 2025; earlier history unknown).
decision: Re-label fiscal quarters to calendar quarters at ingestion (FY Q1 = Apr-Jun = calendar Q2). Pre-2017 employment and unemployment stay missing: no backcasting and no survey-round interpolation.
remaining_action: Confirm there is no continuous pre-2017 all-India quarterly series.

issue: Is the RBI -> MoSPI -> OECD -> BIS order applied strictly, or by original compiler?
decision: Strictly per §7: the first source in the order that actually carries the series. The original compiler is stored as metadata only.

issue: NBS publishes y/y and SA q/q GDP growth, not a confirmed level; employment/hours doubtful; reliability concerns.
decision: No special treatment. NBS -> OECD -> BIS; where no level is published, build an index by chaining NBS SA q/q growth (documented); eligibility is decided by §19 like any country; reliability concerns are documented, not used to exclude.
remaining_action: Verify NBS/OECD availability and start dates.

issue: 'BOJ / official statistics' spans BOJ, Cabinet Office-ESRI, METI, MIC, MHLW; the e-Stat table shows JSDA (bond yields) and Nikkei (stock index) as producers.
decision: 'Official' = the compiling agency's series reached through BOJ Time-Series Data Search, e-Stat or ESRI. Series produced by private bodies (JSDA yields, Nikkei 225) are not official: use the next chain source (OECD) unless official hosting is confirmed. ESRI reference dates: use the §65 list as given and check for a newer release.
remaining_action: Confirm whether BOJ hosts JGB yields; check the latest ESRI dating.

issue: Germany 1990-91 reunification break in long histories.
decision: No manual West-Germany/unified splice. Use the chain source's series as published, record the break in known_issues, and let the audit decide the usable start.

issue: Which countries form the broader panel?
decision: The 31 other OECD members listed here plus China; reconfirm OECD membership on the retrieval date; the final count is fixed only after the audit; the §52 gate applies.

issue: OECD platform changes (OECD.Stat offline 2024-07-01, 60 downloads/hour, dataflow IDs pending) and whether FRED copies of OECD/BIS data may be used for non-US countries.
decision: Use OECD Data Explorer/SDMX only for OECD-chain rows. Do not use FRED copies of OECD/BIS data for non-US countries. Spread queries to stay under 60 per hour. Record dataflow IDs and versions at retrieval.
remaining_action: Resolve dataflow IDs for each indicator.

issue: BIS series keys and coverage unknown; BIS revisions; is the credit-to-GDP gap one-sided?
decision: Record the BIS download date as data_version_id. Use the BIS gap only if its filter is confirmed one-sided; otherwise compute an own one-sided gap inside training windows.
remaining_action: Resolve series keys, coverage and gap documentation.

issue: Series whose producers are outside the §7 list (UMich, CBOE, Chicago Fed, ISM/S&P PMI, EPU, Fed Board EBP, CPB).
decision: Access-source rule: a series is in scope if a §7 source hosts it, whatever its original producer (e.g. University of Michigan sentiment, VIX, NFCI via FRED for the USA). Producers reachable only outside §7 are excluded (non-US EPU, Excess Bond Premium). PMIs (listed in §25) are conditional: kept only where a §7 source hosts them (NBS for China); otherwise excluded after the verification pass.
deviation_detail: §7 is read as listing access sources, not original producers.
remaining_action: Verify FRED hosting of UMCSENT, NFCI, VIX, credit spreads, EPU; confirm whether ISM PMI is hosted.

issue: No §7 hierarchy for global series; how to build aggregates without leakage?
decision: Global series follow the USA chain (FRED first) with IMF/World Bank as supplement. Global, trading-partner and panel aggregates are computed from training countries only and exclude the target and held-out country. World industrial production is built from panel IP (GLB_PANEL_IP); external world IP/trade series are conditional supplements.

issue: NSA-only series: how to adjust without leakage?
decision: Official SA series preferred. If a BEAI input is NSA-only, X-13 is run only on data up to the as-of cutoff. Predictors from NSA-only series use YoY changes.
deviation_detail: The plan does not state an SA rule.

issue: §30 gives lags for four classes only; which class applies to BIS credit, BoP, household accounts, house prices, weekly claims, CPI-based REER? May post-quarter-end financial data enter features?
decision: Quarterly non-national-accounts sources (BIS credit, BoP, household accounts, house prices) -> 1 quarter; weekly claims and CPI-based REER -> 6 weeks. Features for quarter t use only observations dated in quarter t (mean, quarter-end value, intra-quarter change); post-quarter-end days before the origin are not used in primary features.
deviation_detail: §23 says market data 'use observations available by the origin'; I read this as no extra lag, keeping features aligned to the quarter index.

issue: Where do prices, commodities, house prices and surveys enter the §55 groups?
decision: Fixed mapping. Track 1: A = activity (ACT_*, capacity utilisation, orders, construction/housing starts); B = labour (incl. employment, hours); C = income (incl. saving rate); D = credit, financial conditions, equity, house prices; E = prices and expectations/surveys; F = external, commodities, global. Track 2: I = A+B+C; II = +D; III = +E+F.
deviation_detail: No deviation (house prices follow §25's credit list).

issue: §24 targets about 30-60 series per country; the catalogue has more candidates.
decision: Collect P0-P1 first; P2-P3 only after the audit; cap at 60 underlying series per country; prune P3 first, then P2 by redundancy_group.

issue: Reuse terms for University of Michigan, CBOE VIX, NBS, OECD, BIS data.
decision: No redistribution of restricted raw files; the repository holds retrieval scripts and metadata only.
remaining_action: Check each provider's terms in Phase 3.

issue: Which deflator converts nominal series to real?
decision: Headline CPI from the same chain source, unless the source publishes a real series.
deviation_detail: The plan is silent on deflators.

issue: No coverage threshold or imputation rule is stated for predictors.
decision: Core indicators: §19 rule. Predictors: the same >=70% coverage of the target window for inclusion in a country's feature set; no interpolation or forward-fill of macro series; remaining gaps handled inside each fold under training-window rules.
deviation_detail: §19 covers core indicators only; applying its 70% threshold to predictors is my extension.

issue: US house prices: FRED series vs harmonised OECD/BIS series.
decision: Collect both; pooled models use the harmonised series; the US country model uses either, fixed at the audit.

issue: Equity coverage (India, China), price vs total return, and market-cap/GDP source.
decision: Nominal broad price index from the chain, used as log returns and volatility; no real conversion. Market cap/GDP is annual and carried forward with a 1-year lag (Q-31); priority P2 (a candidate per §65; no committed sign, so not a major predictor).
remaining_action: Verify India/China equity coverage and a market-cap/GDP source.

issue: OECD CCI/BCI coverage for India/China; national survey substitution; PMI availability.
decision: OECD CCI/BCI are the harmonised surveys. National surveys only where a chain source hosts them (BOJ Tankan, RBI surveys). No outside substitution.

issue: Will any BEAI-derived variable ever be a predictor?
decision: No BEAI-derived variable (Ft, Rt, turning-point flags, diffusion) is in the predictor set in main experiments; any test must be registered separately as a lagged, information-available feature.

issue: When may IMF/World Bank data replace a chain source?
decision: Only after OECD and BIS (and any earlier chain source) fail for that series; each use is logged with the reason.

issue: Population and market cap/GDP are annual.
decision: Carry forward the last published annual value with a 1-year lag; no interpolation (interpolation would use future information).
deviation_detail: The plan is silent on annual series.

issue: All IDs, start/end dates, missingness, units, SA and revision fields are still PENDING_VERIFICATION.
decision: Run a metadata-only verification pass in Phase 3 (FRED API, OECD SDMX, BIS bulk download, BOJ API, RBI/MoSPI/NBS downloads) and record the retrieval date. It cannot be done from this environment, which has no direct network access to those APIs.
remaining_action: Run the pass; fill every PENDING_VERIFICATION field.

issue: What is the unit of record?
decision: series_key (country x indicator x native frequency x variant) is the primary key; raw files are immutable; cleaned and quarterly series are stored separately.

issue: How to store external chronologies (NBER, ESRI, Dua & Banerji, Euro Area committee)?
decision: As a separate reference table used for plausibility checks only; ESRI dates from §65 as given.
remaining_action: Digitise the chronologies with retrieval dates; check for a newer ESRI release.
